change: pubkit signing-key backup writes the signing keys repositories declare in pubkit.json's new signing_keys block to their Bitwarden projects, each found by its id with its name as a label (a run warns when Bitwarden's name differs; a plain name matches in any case when only one project has it), with the SDK and a token typed at a hidden prompt: one repository, or every one under --under DIR. It skips a key already backed up, never overwrites a different value, points out an undeclared corpus key, and --dry-run asks for nothing. pubkit sync --check refuses a signing_keys block it can't use.
